cd /opt/trading-bot && venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import obbot, json, urllib.request, time
c = obbot.CFG
print({k: c[k] for k in c if k in ("NOTIONAL","FEE_BPS","FEE","LATENCY","TAKER","MAKER","DEPOSIT","START") or "FEE" in k or "NOTION" in k or "BAL" in k or "DEP" in k})
tk = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/24hr"))
ex = {s["symbol"]: s for s in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/exchangeInfo?permissions=SPOT"))["symbols"]}
bad = ("USDC","FDUSD","TUSD","BUSD","USDP","DAI","EUR","TRY","BRL","UP","DOWN","BULL","BEAR","PAXG","WBTC","XUSD","USD1","AEUR","RLUSD","PYUSD","USDE")
cand = []
for t in tk:
    s = t["symbol"]
    if not s.endswith("USDT") or s not in ex or ex[s]["status"] != "TRADING": continue
    base = s[:-4]
    if any(base.startswith(b) or base.endswith(b) for b in bad): continue
    qv = float(t["quoteVolume"])
    if qv < 20e6: continue
    cand.append((qv, s))
cand.sort(reverse=True)
rows = []
for qv, s in cand[:45]:
    try:
        d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/depth?symbol=%s&limit=500" % s))
        b = [(float(p), float(q)) for p, q in d["bids"]]; a = [(float(p), float(q)) for p, q in d["asks"]]
        sp = (a[0][0] - b[0][0]) / b[0][0] * 1e4
        gaps = [b[i][0] - b[i+1][0] for i in range(len(b)-1) if b[i][0] - b[i+1][0] > 0]
        tick = min(gaps) / b[0][0] * 1e4
        depth = sum(p*q for p, q in b if (b[0][0]-p)/b[0][0]*1e4 <= 60)
        span = (b[0][0]-b[-1][0])/b[0][0]*1e4
        rows.append((s, qv/1e6, sp, tick, depth/1e3, span))
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    time.sleep(0.15)
print("пара | оборот24ч млн | спред б.п. | тик б.п. | bid до 60б.п. тыс | глубина стакана б.п.")
for r in rows:
    print("%-9s %7.0f %6.2f %6.2f %8.0f %7.0f" % r)
PY
